title: Prospect of war with Iran is 'crisis of Trump's own making'
summary: PRESS REVIEW – Wednesday, February 25, 2026: The prospect of war between the United States and Iran is getting a lot of coverage. But first, French papers discuss the municipal elections, which are taking place in a few weeks' time. Also, a report about the future of AI causes a few wobbles in the stock market. Finally, a baby giraffe with a strange haircut…
